data.name: VSG_001
data.value: The mist is even thicker here...[pause=15] It's almost unreal.

data.name: VSG_002
data.value: This is the heart of the steppe.[pause=20] Something must be protecting this place.

data.name: VSG_003
data.value: Its antlers...[pause=10] they're glowing!

data.name: VSG_004
data.value: The Warden of the Plains awakens...

data.name: VSG_005
data.value: That voice again!

data.name: VSG_006
data.value: The strongest of the herd.[pause=20] He will not yield so easily.

data.name: VSG_007
data.value: Prove your worth, traveler...

data.name: VSG_008
data.value: This is the last obstacle before the end of the steppe![pause=10] Let's go!

data.name: VSG_009
data.value: We're charging back in.[pause=15] This time, we've got this!

data.name: VSG_010
data.value: We defeated the guardian of the steppe!

data.name: VSG_011
data.value: The mist is starting to clear...

data.name: VSG_012
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It knew he was here.

data.name: VSG_013
data.value: We'll find answers later.[pause=20] Let's move forward.

data.name: VSG_014
data.value: The Warden shows no mercy to the weak.

data.name: VSG_015
data.value: Go back where you came from.[pause=30] Return when you are ready.

data.name: VSG_016
data.value: On...[pause=10] on n'y arrive pas ![pause=15] Il est trop puissant !

data.name: VSG_017
data.value: Le Gardien baisse la tête.[pause=20] Ses bois émettent une dernière lueur.

data.name: VSG_018
data.value: Tu n'es pas encore prêt, voyageur.[pause=30] Mais tu as du cœur.

data.name: VSG_019
data.value: L'Alpha te regarde partir sans bouger.[pause=25] Il retourne veiller sur la steppe.

data.name: VSG_020
data.value: Le Gardien s'effondre dans un grondement sourd.[pause=15] La brume autour de lui se dissipe.

data.name: VSG_021
data.value: Ses bois s'éteignent doucement.[pause=20] Il te regarde avec... du respect ?

data.name: VSG_022
data.value: Tu es digne, étranger.[pause=25] La steppe est à toi.

data.name: VSG_023
data.value: Il s'évanouit dans la brume, laissant derrière lui un silence apaisé.

data.name: VSG_024
data.value: On a vaincu le Gardien...[pause=15] On a vraiment réussi.

data.name: VSG_025
data.value: Même les plus grands gardiens finissent par s'incliner.[pause=25] Tu progresses.
